reviews.text: Obie looks forward to his school days! He loves trainers Bennett, Jacobi & Kendall. He has come a long way since beginning at Revival, and we look forward to continuing his education. 🐶

Highly recommend Revival Dog Training! We love them!

Our 5-month-old English Bulldog, Bruce, has been coming here for about a month and a half, and he absolutely loves it! He gets so excited to come that his entire body shakes when Jakobi comes out to get him. I’ll admit, we were really nervous about leaving him at first because English Bulldogs need to be monitored closely due to their sensitivity to heat and potential breathing issues. We came in and met the entire team, and they took the time to answer all of our questions and concerns, which made us feel so much more comfortable. Bruce has learned so much already! The videos they send home for homework are incredibly helpful and easy to follow. We practice with him at home, and he does great! He had a little difficulty with “down” and recall, so I let the team know, and they focused on those skills with him again. Now he’s got them down! I can genuinely tell that this team is passionate about what they do and truly cares about the animals. As pet parents, that means so much to us and makes us feel great about bringing Bruce here.

We’ve even recommended Revival to a friend whose puppy is attending their puppy kindergarten program, and they love it too!

If you’re looking for a team that genuinely cares about your dog while helping them learn and grow, I highly recommend Revival Dog Training!

I've been taking my 2 dogs here for boarding over the past few years and they're always happy to go! I get photos of my pups each day and it has been an easy drop off/pick up process for me. Convenient to schedule and happy pups - what more do you need?
Well trained staff. Friendly with both dogs plus owners!
Staff was very friendly and communicated updates throughout the stay! Our dog didn’t want to leave!

Highly recommend Revival. Our dogs have made marked progress on so many behavioral and obedience metrics, and the staff have been open, communicative and lovely to work with. Trainer Jacobi in particular brings an incredible amount of knowledge, thoughtfulness and nimble decision-making to day training. He is clearly a dog-whisperer; in two short months he arrived at breakthroughs that have eluded me with both of my young dogs, one an anxious shy boy and the other more of a chaos goblin. The personalization and individual care for each animal has been really special to watch unfold. You'll be working with very skilled and trustworthy trainers here.

Just had our first private training session with Bennett. Amazing experience. He clearly communicated expectations with us and our dog. He made all of us feel comfortable with his style of training. He truly cares about our dog and helping him learn essential manners/techniques to be happy and well behaved. Will definitely be continuing with Bennett and the Revival team!

Our older fur baby, Kahlua, (10 years old) had a lot of problems that we were hoping to correct. Leash pulling, reactivity towards dogs, eating garbage on walks, and staying calm in new environments. We’re also preparing for an overseas flight and were worried about how she would do! Given her age I was worried that we wouldn’t see much progress. However, she did a 2 week board + train followed by 10 training day sessions and she has improved immensely!!!

I am so grateful to the team for all they’ve done for us. I write this from the airport after our long journey (she did great, airport pics below!) she can now go for walks without foraging or pulling, be in new places without getting too overstimulated, and she can pass dogs on walks without barking incessantly. The one time in home training was also so helpful to reinforce all that she had learned. Thank you team!! You’ve done what I thought was impossible.

I would recommend Revival to anyone who’s looking to correct stubborn behaviors.

We absolutely love and trust the team at Revival. Our dog goes regularly and absolutely loves it. The team send us photos when she is there and they are always responsive and caring. They really care for the dogs, there was one time that Houston got a very serious storm and the entire area loss power. It was the summer and super hot. Out dog was the only one left and one of the team members offered to take out dog home so she could be in a climate control environment for that night. Jacobi, Kristin and Sky are amazing and true dog lovers!

Revival Dog Training has been a great experience for my dogs. They are always excited when we pull up for boarding, which says a lot! The team communicates well, sends photo updates during their stay, and is always as flexible and accommodating as possible. It gives me peace of mind knowing my dogs are happy and well cared for while I’m away.
We love Revival! Our dogs are always sad to leave.  I am so appreciative of how they care for the dogs when they are boarded.
We’ve had a great experience with Revival! Our reactive dog has learned so much via their board & train and day training programs. Definitely recommend to anyone looking for training for their pup!

Revival is our dog’s favorite place. She is anxious and reactive around other dogs but her time at Revival has opened a new world for her to learn and play. Our pup knows the days of the week only because Tuesday is Rec Club day. She wakes up STOKED to go and see her best friend Kristol and play all day. She comes home the best kind of tired and would spend every day there if she could. We are so thankful for Revival for their immense love and careful care of our furbaby :)

Finding the right daycare and boarding place for our dog has not been easy — until we found Revival. Our dog, Leia, is an anxious, reactive German Shepherd mix, so finding a place where she feels truly comfortable has always been challenging. At other places in the past, drop-offs were stressful because she struggled being separated from me. Revival has completely changed that.

Now, Leia knows when it’s a daycare day from the moment we wake up and gets genuinely excited to go. She happily says goodbye at drop-off and runs in excitedly — something I honestly never thought we’d see. It gives us so much peace of mind knowing she feels safe, happy, and cared for there.

She comes home SO tired in the best possible way, which tells me she’s getting great exercise, enrichment, and attention throughout the day.

A special thank you to Kristol, who Leia absolutely adores. It’s so clear that Kristol genuinely loves and cares about Leia, and that kind of connection means everything when you’re trusting someone with your dog, especially one with anxiety and reactivity challenges.

Revival has been an absolute game changer for us. If you’re looking for daycare or boarding, especially for a dog that needs extra patience, understanding, and care, we cannot recommend Revival enough.

I’ve had a wonderful experience with Revival Dog Training. My stubborn Shih Tzu has made so much progress  he’s less distracted now, responds to his name consistently, and even sees his kennel as a safe and comfortable place now. Everyone there has been patient, encouraging, and great at communicating throughout the process. I especially appreciate their flexibility and how supportive they’ve been with both me and my dog. Highly recommend

My dog Charles has been attending rec club and boarding here for years and we absolutely love it!  The team puts in so much effort to get to know each dog and best fulfill their needs. It gives me such peace of mind to know Charles is in great hands whenever I’m traveling.

We enrolled our 4 month puppy Nala to Revival’s Dog Training. She spent 10 training sessions with Jacobi. Their relationship continues to be so sweet. Nala is a sweet but cautious puppy. She has developed strong skills during the course of her training at Revival. Nala was not fully potty trained when she began but is now. She has improved dramatically in her ability to walk/heel and stay beside us. The biggest achievements have been Jacobi’s help in orienting her to busy, nosy, and unexpected everyday environments so she is less frightened and is able to refocus on us. We are grateful for Jacobi’s patience and work with her, and the encouraging attention other trainers like Kristol and Skye have given her. Thank you!!

My dog went twice a week for day training and it definitely improved the skills we wanted to work on like loose leash walking! Everyone is so nice and does a great job at communicating. I love to see the videos of what they worked on that day! It is definitely pricy but for a short time it was a good solution as regular daycare at other places often feels too unpredictable. I trusted that my dog was in great hands each day! I would love to know a little more about how often they are trained vs kenneled but I know it changes day to day depending on skills they worked on. Overall I would recommend Revival Dog Training and am grateful for their help and care!

Honestly the best training facility and boarding that I have brought my furry baby too. Their team is great and so helpful. Especially trainer Jacobi, he’s so professional and caring. Always keeps me in the loop of what’s going on. The videos are great too. Also, the facility is nice and clean.
Best  crew in town, wouldn’t go any where else for boarding or daycare!

My 3-year old goldendoodle is a Revival Training devotee.  As a puppy she enjoyed the Puppy K program.  She learned not to be afraid of new things - and she loved playtime. We moved within Houston and I was delighted there is a Revival Training Heights location.  Hazel has been attending what I call "puppy play" once a week for over a year.  She is overjoyed when it's Play Day - she sees me pour her kibble into a bag and then she breaks squeaky oodly doodly songs.  Upon arrival she hops inside the Revival Heights gate and is off for a full, fun day.  The enrichment games, training, and full on play with other pups makes her so happy.  She has boarded at the Heights location as well with great success. Me and Hazel are big fans of Revival Training Heights.

Admittedly, we would rather keep this place a secret, but after almost two years of sending our dog to Revival in the Heights, we will never send our dog to daycare or boarding outside of Skye & Cristol. You cannot put a price on feeling that your dog is always safe (even in a tornado) - let alone to see how excited he is to visit his extended family. We recently moved, and I can confirm that this is the only service we continue to - and will always - use no matter the drive. This is what a business is supposed to look like.

We had the privilege of being apart of the height training program for about 8 months. Sky and Crystal are phenomenal! One of our dogs is terrified of everything and she was soo excited to go every week to see them. They really helped both of our dogs grow in their individual needs. The only reason we stopped was due to moving. Seriously worth every penny. Can't speaker higher of this company and all they have to offer! I will continue to go back for all boarding needs despite a drive. I truly trust them with fur babies and know they care for them like their own.

I enrolled my dog in 3 months of training with Revival and have seen a noticeable, positive difference in his behavior and command response. The trainers were great and my dog enjoyed participating in the training. I would definitely recommend Revival.

We started our pup Heidi at Revival when she was around 6 months old as we wanted to focus on training as well as positive socialization with other dogs. She’s a bundle of energy and going to “school” was her favorite part of the week- when your dog whines at the gate to be let in and doesn’t want to leave, that’s usually a good sign they love it there. The staff has always been so great, excellent with communication, providing great feedback for training and they were always flexible with ours or Heidi’s needs. We would HIGHLY recommend going through a training program there if you’re looking for additional support, structure or reinforcement on what you’re trying to teach at home.

I sent my high-energy dog to Skye and Kristol for daycare (and occasional boarding) and had the best experience. They truly cared for Maeve and strengthened her training foundation with so much play, enrichment, and structure. Having to leave Revival was one of the hardest parts of my recent cross-country move--what they provide just doesn't exist anywhere else.

Our golden retriever Bean boarded at the heights location in May.
We dropped her off knowing that she would be safe, cared for and would receive all the pets and cuddles while we were gone on vacation!
Skye went above and beyond and took her on a field trip and gave her all the love and cuddles during her stay. Kristol helped update us on a daily basis.
We are so appreciative of the trainers at revival heights location!

My Spinone, Tallulah, started going to Revival in the Heights starting in January. She finished up her puppy training classes at the West U training and I moved her to The Heights to be closer to home. Tallulah goes one day a week for Training Days to make sure she keeps her manners. Skye and Kristol are awesome and keep me updated on what they work on each week. Tallulah is always so excited at drop off and plenty tired at the end of the day. We love it there!

We absolutely love Revival Rec Club. Yennifer and Hayley have trained our dog since he was a puppy, and he used to go to their West U location. When they opened in the Heights we were so excited! Kristol and Skye are great! They know our dog and work with him every day on training. He absolutely loves coming here and loves all of the trainers. Most importantly, they all LOVE these dogs like their own. They are trustworthy and truly love your dog. Can’t recommend them enough!

My dogs have both been going to the Rec Club, and for boarding at this location for over a year and we love it. They get to play with carefully matched pups, a wide variety of enrichment and reinforcement of basic manners. Skye and Krystol …

We couldn’t be happier with our experience at Revival Rec Club. Our aussie Penny has been going here once a week for over a year and she always has an amazing time. Kristol and Skye take the best care of Penny and always find new ways for …

I can't say enough about Revival Dog Training! They've been absolutely amazing in helping my dog, Max, overcome his anxiety and reactivity. The trainers are incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and truly care about the well-being of both the …

Our puppy stayed at this boarding for 10 days and she absolutely loved it! The personnel were super friendly and they considered all our specific requests about taking care of her. We also requested puppy training and been receiving videos …

Safe, Loving and Fun! That’s what boarding is like at Revival Dog Training in the Heights. Our dog, Archie doesn’t even look back when we drop him off for boarding because he has so much fun. I love the photos that we receive while we are on vacation too!
My dog seemed very happy 😃 …

We have used Revival for both training and Boarding and have been pleased on both fronts. Most recently, we left them over the New Year's holidays for a week. The Revival team kept us updated daily, even providing videos! It was much easier to leave them knowing that they were being well kept for (and having fun!)
